403.description: Missing app:activate returns insufficient_scope with requiredScope. Suspended commercial operations return commercial_dunning_suspended.

404.description: The resource is unavailable

409.description: The environment is retired (environment_retired), or production app capacity is exhausted (production_app_allowance_exhausted).

422.description: Confirmation, lifecycle, active-policy, HTTPS registration, or OIDC-profile readiness failed: confirmation_required, invalid_lifecycle_transition, policy_required, invalid_endpoints, or invalid_oidc_profile.

428.description: A current environment version precondition is required.

patch.description: Activate a production draft with action activate, confirmed true, and the current expectedVersion. If If-Match is also supplied, both versions must match. A workspace service key needs effective app:activate permission for the exact workspace, app, and production environment, and can only perform this first activation. An active policy, at least one registered HTTPS redirect URI, and a valid DPoP-bound public or confidential OIDC profile are required. Human lifecycle changes require authentication within 15 minutes. Resume is a separate human action for suspended environments. An already-active activation is rejected; reconcile uncertain delivery through GET before retrying. Production app allowance and suspended commercial-operation rules are enforced in the activation transaction; rejected or rolled-back activation does not consume capacity.

sessionCookie.description: Server-side platform session. Never expose this value to browser bundles or logs.

managementOAuth.description: Server-side management OAuth bearer issued for an owner-created workspace delegation. This scheme is supported only on operations that list it explicitly, currently workspace reads, and requires x-authless-client: server. Never use a browser session cookie as an agent credential.

scopes.workspace:read: Read workspaces available to the authorized owner

recoveryCookie.name: __Host-authless_recovery
recoveryCookie.description: Bounded recovery authority. Never expose this value in response bodies, browser bundles, or logs.

appCredential.description: Server-side credential scoped to one exact app environment. Never expose this value to browser bundles, logs, examples, or diagnostics.

workspaceServiceBearer.description: A workspace service credential. Its scopes and app/environment restrictions are checked for every request.

amountMicros.description: Price in Authless micros: major units multiplied by 1,000,000, then converted to minor units using the currency exponent. For USD, 10,000,000 micros = 1,000 minor units = $10.
Price in Authless micros: major units multiplied by 1,000,000, then converted to minor units using the currency exponent. For USD, 10,000,000 micros = 1,000 minor units = $10.

CreateWorkspaceRequest.description: Creates a workspace with a normalized name. Names are 1–80 characters, may contain Unicode letters or numbers plus spaces, periods, ampersands, apostrophes, parentheses, underscores, and hyphens, and cannot use reserved names such as admin, authless, personal, root, support, or system.

name.description: Workspace display name. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed and internal whitespace is normalized before validation. Reserved names and unsupported punctuation are rejected by the server.

ErrorEnvelope.description: RFC 9457-compatible problem details. The stable error member is an Authless extension; omitted standard members retain their RFC defaults.

requiredScope.description: Scope required when error is insufficient_scope.

type.description: Problem type URI; defaults to about:blank when omitted.

detail.description: Safe occurrence-specific explanation with no credential or tenant-private data.

instance.description: Occurrence URI reference when the server exposes one.

correlationId.description: Request correlation identifier safe to share with support.

publicJwks.description: Replacement public JWK set. Private key material is never accepted or returned.

expectedVersion.description: Optional numeric key-version precondition. Supply this field or the If-Match header; exactly one version channel is required.

CreateAppRequest.description: Registers an app in a workspace. The server trims the name and description and normalizes the owner contact email to lowercase.

examples.description: Customer sign-in for the Example product
examples.name: Example web app

name.description: App display name. Maximum 80 characters after trimming.

ownerContactEmail.description: Operational owner contact address. It is normalized to lowercase and must be a valid email address.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration. Omit or send null for a credential that does not expire; an explicit date creates a temporary credential.
Optional expiration. Omit or send null to preserve a non-expiring credential; an explicit date creates a temporary credential.
Null means this credential does not expire.
